mapper.select: SELECT r.*, o.name AS organization_name FROM salary_rule r LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = r.organization_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT * FROM salary_rule WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (organization_id = #{organizationId} OR organization_id IS NULL) AND (grade = #{grade} OR grade IS NULL OR grade = '') AND (subject = #{subject} OR subject IS NULL OR subject = '') ORDER BY (organization_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, (grade IS NOT NULL AND grade != '') DESC, (subject IS NOT NULL AND subject != '') DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_rule(user_id, organization_id, grade, subject, hourly_fee, remark) VALUES(#{userId}, #{organizationId}, #{grade}, #{subject}, #{hourlyFee}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE salary_rule SET organization_id = #{organizationId}, grade = #{grade}, subject = #{subject}, hourly_fee = #{hourlyFee}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM salary_rule WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
